caption: The drawing features a large square pattern centrally placed on an off-white background. This central square consists of an intricate, tightly-arranged grid of smaller squares and rectangles, predominantly shaded in varying tones of blue, teal, and black. The grid forms an overall geometric, almost woven visual effect, and in certain sections, distinctive wavy lines and irregular color bands run vertically through the pattern, causing a sense of distortion in the grid. Below and to the right of the main square is a smaller, lighter, monochrome grid drawn in fine gray lines, featuring similar but less intense geometric motifs. On the lower left, the name “HARRY JENNINGS” is faintly inscribed in small, spaced-out capital letters. The entire composition is displayed on a blank, untextured background, leaving significant empty space around the grids.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
